title: "Analysis of GCase Activity in GBA1 Single Variant Cell Lines"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Overview
This analysis investigates the difference in GCase activity within GBA1 single variant expressing cell lines treated with LysoFix.

Analysis included shown in figure 5

```{r packages}
library(readxl)
library(writexl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)
library(multcomp)

```

# Load raw data
Input flow cytometry analysis of LysoFix treatment within each GBA1 single variant expressing line and MAVE flow-seq data

```{r load-data}
SingleVariant_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Single Variant Raw_LysoFix.xlsx")
MAVE_MasterFile_Input <- readxl::read_excel("Supplementary Table 2_MAVE Master File.xlsx")
```

# Preparing Data
```{r preparing data}
ControlVariant <- c("Unmodified Cells", "KO", "WT")
StartCodon_Variant <- c("M1A", "M21A")
WorseThanStopCodon_Variant <- c("D166G", "Y352K")
PathogenicVariant <- c("R159W", "G241R", "V414L", "V433L", "D448H", "L483P", "R502C")
LikelyPathogenicVariant <- c("S310G", "N409S", "W417G", "V437I", "V499L")
BenignVariant <- "E365K"
VUS <- c("R83C", "T408M", "N231K", "R324H", "P358L", "V391L", "A495P")

Input_annotated <- SingleVariant_Input %>%
  filter(Condition %in% "LysoFix") %>%
  dplyr::select(Test, Cell_Line, Condition, Median, Robust_SD, Median_FoldChange, Median_FoldChange_Reduction) %>%
  mutate(MAVE_grouping = case_when(
    Cell_Line %in% ControlVariant ~ "Control",
    Cell_Line %in% PathogenicVariant ~ "Pathogenic",
    Cell_Line %in% LikelyPathogenicVariant ~ "Likely Pathogenic",
    Cell_Line %in% BenignVariant ~ "Benign",
    Cell_Line %in% VUS ~ "VUS",
    Cell_Line %in% StartCodon_Variant ~ "Start Codon",
    Cell_Line %in% WorseThanStopCodon_Variant ~ "Worse than Stop Codon",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_   
  )) %>%
  mutate(Cell_Line = factor(Cell_Line, levels = c("Unmodified Cells", "KO", "WT",
                                                  "R159W", "G241R", "V414L", "V433L", 
                                                  "D448H", "L483P", "R502C", "S310G", 
                                                  "N409S", "W417G", "V437I", "V499L",
                                                  "E365K",
                                                  "R83C", "N231K", "R324H", "P358L", 
                                                  "V391L", "T408M", "A495P",
                                                  " ",
                                                  "M1A", "M21A",
                                                  "D166G", "Y352K")))  %>%
  mutate(MAVE_grouping = factor(MAVE_grouping, levels = c("Control", "Pathogenic",
                                                          "Likely Pathogenic", 
                                                          "Benign",
                                                          "VUS",
                                                          "Start Codon",
                                                          "Worse than Stop Codon"))) 
```

# Performing statistical analysis 
```{r stats analysis}

Input_annotated$Cell_Line <- relevel(Input_annotated$Cell_Line, ref = "WT")
levels(Input_annotated$Cell_Line)

# Stats
model <- aov(Median_FoldChange ~ Cell_Line, data = Input_annotated)

glht_model <- glht(
  model,
  linfct = mcp(Cell_Line = "Dunnett")
)

dunnett <- summary(glht_model)

estimates <- dunnett$test$coefficients
pvals <- dunnett$test$pvalues
tstats <- dunnett$test$tstat
se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(glht_model)))

Dunnett_table <- data.frame(
  comparison = names(estimates),
  estimate = estimates,
  std_error = se,
  t_stat = tstats,
  p_value = pvals
)


Dunnett_table$significance <- cut(Dunnett_table$p_value,
                                            breaks = c(-Inf, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, Inf),
                                            labels = c("****", "***", "**", "*", "ns"))

Stats <- Dunnett_table %>%
  mutate(Variant = sub(" - WT$", "", comparison))
```

# Plotting Single Variant GCase Assay Data
```{r plotting}

sig_positions <- Input_annotated %>%
  group_by(Cell_Line) %>%
  summarise(
    y_pos = max(Median_FoldChange, na.rm = TRUE) +
      if (as.character(first(Cell_Line)) %in% c("R502C", "V414L", "M1A")) {
        0.1
      } else {
        0.05
      },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Merge with Dunnett significance table
sig_labels <- Stats %>%
  dplyr::select(Variant, significance) %>%
  rename(Cell_Line = Variant) %>%
  left_join(sig_positions, by = "Cell_Line")


Selection_Colours <- c("Control" = "white", 
                       "Pathogenic" = "#C62828",
                       "Likely Pathogenic" = "#F9A825",
                       "Benign" = "#1565C0",
                       "VUS" = "#7E57C2",
                       "Start Codon" = "grey",
                       "Worse than Stop Codon" = "black")

# Plotting Median Fold Change for each variant
MedianFoldChange_TestComp_plot <- Input_annotated %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Cell_Line, y = Median_FoldChange)) +
  
  # mean bar
  stat_summary(aes(fill = MAVE_grouping),
               fun = mean, 
               geom = "col", 
               width = 0.7, 
               color = "black",  
               linewidth = 0.1 , alpha = 0.6) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = Selection_Colours,
                    name = NULL) +
  # individual points
  geom_jitter(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.1,
    height = 0,
    size = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  
  # SE error bars
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.7,    
    color = "black",  
    linewidth = 0.1  
  ) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, 
             color = "darkgreen", 
             alpha = 1, 
             linewidth = 0.1,    
             linetype = "dashed") + 
  geom_text(
    data = sig_labels,
    aes(x = Cell_Line,
        y = y_pos,
        label = significance),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  # axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
  
  labs(
    x = "GBA1 Variant",
    y = "Median Fold Change",
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    # backgrounds
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    # grid lines (light + clean)
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, angle = 55, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm")
    )

print(MedianFoldChange_TestComp_plot)

ggsave("Median_FoldChange.pdf", 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       plot = MedianFoldChange_TestComp_plot, 
       width = 100,
       height = 100,
       units = "mm",
       bg = "transparent")
```


# Performing Comparison between MAVE Flow-Seq Scores and Single Variant Assay
```{r MAVE vs Single Variant}

Median_Summary_Table <- Input_annotated %>%
  dplyr::select(Cell_Line, Test, Median_FoldChange_Reduction, MAVE_grouping) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Test,
    values_from = Median_FoldChange_Reduction
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Flow_N   = sum(!is.na(c(`Exp 1`, `Exp 2`, `Exp 3`))),
    Flow_Mean = mean(c(`Exp 1`, `Exp 2`, `Exp 3`), na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_SD   = sd(c(`Exp 1`, `Exp 2`, `Exp 3`), na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_SE   = Flow_SD / sqrt(Flow_N),
    Flow_Min  = min(c(`Exp 1`, `Exp 2`, `Exp 3`), na.rm = TRUE),
    Flow_Max  = max(c(`Exp 1`, `Exp 2`, `Exp 3`), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Variant = Cell_Line)

MAVE_Plus_Flow <- MAVE_MasterFile_Input %>%
  filter(Variant %in% c(StartCodon_Variants, WorseThanStopCodon_Variants, Pathogenic, LikelyPathogenic, Benign, VUS)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Variant,
    MAVE_Score,
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MAVE_Score = as.numeric(MAVE_Score),
  ) %>%
  left_join(Median_Summary_Table, by = "Variant")


# Calculating Pearson Correlation 
Correlation_Data <- MAVE_Plus_Flow %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(MAVE_Score),
    !is.na(Flow_Mean)
  )

Pearson_test <- cor.test(
  Correlation_Data$MAVE_Score,
  Correlation_Data$Flow_Mean,
  method = "pearson"
)

# Extract Pearson correlation statistics 
r <- unname(Pearson_test$estimate) 
p <- Pearson_test$p.value 
CI <- Pearson_test$conf.int 

# Display results Pearson_test 
r 
p 
CI 

# Range of MAVE scores used in the Pearson correlation 
range(Correlation_Data$MAVE_Score, na.rm = TRUE)


Spearman_test <- cor.test(
  Correlation_Data$MAVE_Score,
  Correlation_Data$Flow_Mean,
  method = "spearman",
  exact = FALSE
)

# Extract Spearman correlation statistics 
Spearman_r <- unname(Spearman_test$estimate) 
Spearman_p <- Spearman_test$p.value 

# Display Spearman results 
Spearman_test 
Spearman_r 
Spearman_p

#Plotting MAVE vs Single Variant Flow
MAVE_vs_Flow_Plot <- ggplot(MAVE_Plus_Flow, aes(x = MAVE_Score, y = Flow_Mean)) +
  
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.9, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.15) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.9, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.15) +
  
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              se = TRUE,        
              color = "black",
              linewidth = 0.2) +
  

  geom_point(aes(color = MAVE_grouping),
             size = 1, alpha = 0.6, shape = 16) +


  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Variant),
    size = 2,
    box.padding = 0.8, 
    point.padding = 0.1, 
    segment.color = "black",   
    segment.size = 0.25,
    nudge_y = 0.08,
    max.overlaps = Inf           
  ) +
  
  # apply your custom colours
  scale_color_manual(values = Selection_Colours,
                     name = NULL) +
  
  # y-axis limits
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-125, 25),
    breaks = c(-125, -100, -75, -50, -25, 0)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-1.3, 0.2),
    breaks = c(-1.2, -1.0, -0.8, -0.6, -0.4, -0.2, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Flow-Seq Variant Score",
    y = "Single Variant Validation\n% Fold Change Reduction",
    color = "Selection Reasoning"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("r = ", round(r, 3)),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.1),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
    
    # grid lines (light + clean)
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.1),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.key.width = unit(0.4, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    axis.line = element_blank()
)

print(MAVE_vs_Flow_Plot)


ggsave("MAVE_vs_Flow_Plot.pdf", 
       device = cairo_pdf,
       plot = MAVE_vs_Flow_Plot, 
       width = 85,
       height = 85,
       units = "mm",
       bg = "transparent")

```
